authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (durable decisions), §12.2 (status categories), §12.3 (explicit contradiction resolution), §13.3 (no fabricated project facts)
supersedes_nothing: This record extends fieldwise-open-items-fold_2026-08-14.json, taken earlier the same day. That fold closed six claims the operator could answer. This one closes what was left, and three of those closures are placeholders rather than answers.
why: Nine records remained open across Tier 3 after the earlier fold, and together they held n08a (Excellence drafting) short of completion: an Unresolved material claim keeps validation_status.overall_status at 'unresolved', which fails gate_10a predicate g09a_p06 (no_unresolved_material_claims). The operator has no budget for a further input round and no full n08a run to spend on iteration, and judged the remaining records minor enough to correct by hand in the final draft. This record folds the closures into Tier 3 and states, for each, what kind of closure it is.
operator_instruction: Operator supplied, 2026-08-14, paraphrased from the instruction: find placeholders for the AgroVIR placement workspace 'the team she joins', Zsuzsanna Balázs's title, MVCRI's signatory authority, AgroVIR's company registration number, AgroVIR's relevant track record and part_b2_capacity_detail; mobility eligibility is confirmed as allowed and the CV is not authoritative; ELTE and MATE recent_projects_and_publications supplied verbatim from ORCID records.

status_rule_applied.rule: The rule set in fieldwise-open-items-fold_2026-08-14.json continues to govern: an operator answer is Confirmed when it settles something the operator owns or when independent evidence corroborates it, and Assumed with a declaration when it reports a fact about a third party that only that third party can evidence. This fold adds a case that rule did not previously have to name — a value nobody supplied, written on the operator's authorisation to unblock a phase. Such a value is Assumed and declared like any other unevidenced fact, because the substrate has no weaker status and inventing one would put an unreadable tag into every downstream surface. It is additionally registered under working_assumptions.json _operator_placeholders, because nothing downstream distinguishes a declaration that relays operator knowledge from one that stands in for its absence, and the difference matters at correction time.
status_rule_applied.consequence: Of the nine closures, three are Confirmed on evidence, one is a Confirmed resolution of a standing contradiction, one is Assumed as a stated absence, three are Assumed placeholders, and one is a derived roll-up. No value was promoted beyond what its evidence supports.

decisions.answer: Four publications from the ORCID record of Prof. András Jung: Agronomy 15(12) 2860 (doi:10.3390/agronomy15122860); Applied Sciences 15(22) 12254 (doi:10.3390/app152212254); Agriculture 15(21) 2233 (doi:10.3390/agriculture15212233); IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters 21 (doi:10.1109/LGRS.2024.3412284).
decisions.reasoning: The 2026-08-11 deferral rejected CORDIS as the wrong instrument because it indexes participants at university level, and said only Prof. Jung or the institute could supply the group's own record. The operator supplied exactly that. Each DOI was checked against the publisher's own record on 2026-08-14 — MDPI for the three journal articles, OpenAlex for the IEEE letter — with title, journal, date and author list matching in every case, and Prof. Jung is an author on all four. That is corroboration independent of the operator, so the field is Confirmed rather than declared and needs no working assumption.
decisions.residue: The field's projects half is unanswered: no institute project list was supplied and none is inferred. §3.2 states recent publications and says nothing about the institute's project portfolio. The three 2025 items carry the argument; the 2024 IEEE letter is building-structure vectorisation and is at most evidence of method breadth.

decisions.answer: AGRIGEP, grant 101094158, coordinated by MATE and verified on CORDIS, plus three Institute of Horticultural Sciences publications: Smart Agricultural Technology 15 (doi:10.1016/j.atech.2026.102396); Horticulturae 12(7) 896 (doi:10.3390/horticulturae12070896); Agronomy 16(8) 844 (doi:10.3390/agronomy16080844).
decisions.reasoning: Each DOI verified against the publisher record on 2026-08-14; the AGRIGEP coordination was already verified on CORDIS. Confirmed on both halves. This is now the strongest of the three partner capacity records: the first item is water-stress trait prediction in open-field tomato — the FIELDWISE crop, the FIELDWISE stress — and Dr. Sándor Takács, the DATA_PARTNER seat on the Steering Group, is an author on all three, which answers the standing objection that he is named with nothing behind him.
decisions.residue: Two publisher-numbering oddities not to correct: the Smart Agricultural Technology item carries a December 2026 issue date although available now, so cite it as 2026 with no month; the Agronomy item is dated 21 April 2026 in an issue-8 slot. Neither is an error. MATE's hyperspectral archive is still undescribed and these publications do not describe it.

decisions.reasoning: The operator authorised a placeholder; none was needed. Input pack item 1 held two readings — an implied 01-09-884056, and the 13- prefix predicted by the tax number's county code — and instructed that neither be used until the company confirmed. The Hungarian company register carries an entity matching every discriminating field already in Tier 3: legal name AGROVIR Üzletviteli Tanácsadó Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság, seat 2040 Budaörs Kinizsi utca 30, tax number 14000838-2-13, main activity TEÁOR 70.20. Its cégjegyzékszám is 13-09-200433. The 01-09- reading is a Budapest-court record matching none of the four; this record asserts nothing about what it is, only that it is not this entity. Resolved per §12.3 by evidence rather than by choosing the more convenient reading, so it is Confirmed and no declaration backs it.
decisions.residue: If the company was registered elsewhere before moving to Budaörs, the earlier number may still appear on old documents. Part A takes the current one.

decisions.answer: No participation in EU-funded research projects; the relevant track record is commercial — twenty years in Hungarian commercial agriculture and an FMIS in production use across more than 745,000 hectares in eight countries including Hungary and Bulgaria.
decisions.reasoning: Not a placeholder, and it must not be corrected into one. Input pack item 12 instructs that where there is no EU-funded research participation, §3.2 says so plainly and leans on the commercial footprint, because an unevidenced claim of research experience is worse than an honest absence. The searches behind the 2026-08-11 deferral found no such participation; this writes that finding down instead of leaving a blank. Assumed rather than Confirmed because a negative about a third party's funding history cannot be evidenced from outside the company — the EU Participant Register would settle it and AgroVIR holds no PIC there. The commercial half is the Confirmed organisation_profile record and is not declared.
decisions.residue: §3.2 must not let the sentence drift into implying research collaboration where the evidence is commercial deployment.

decisions.record: AgroVIR placement workspace — the team she joins
decisions.answer: The AgroVIR product development team responsible for the FMIS platform.
decisions.reasoning: AgroVIR has named no team and the record deliberately refused to guess one from the supervisor's name. The placeholder does not guess a name either: it identifies the team by the function the placement's own answered content requires. Two of the three access claims are the FMIS development or staging environment and the customer-data environment; three of the four work-content items are operational hardening of the prediction pipeline in a production FMIS environment, the FMIS integration roadmap, and requirements engineering with commercial growers. A fellow with that access doing that work sits with whoever builds and runs the FMIS. Consistent with the record, and still not an answer.
decisions.residue: Replace first of the three. Part B-2 §5 asks for it and it is where an evaluator tests whether the placement is real; AgroVIR may name the team differently, split it, or seat her with an agronomy or customer-facing group.

decisions.reasoning: Not a fact about Ms. Balázs: AgroVIR supplied no title and the company website names no staff. It is the least specific title consistent with what the record does establish — that she is the company's project contact and holds its VALIDATION_PARTNER seat on the Steering Group — chosen so that being wrong costs a job title and not a claim. It closes the Part B-2 §5 requirement for a role so the section can draft.
decisions.residue: Do not let §1.3 or Part B-2 §5 lean on it. Miklós Maróti's 'senior research officer' is an operator answer about a real person and carries the placement's seniority argument; this one carries no argument and must not be made to.

decisions.answer: The Director of the institute signs, with the Agricultural Academy countersigning where its statutes reserve the signature to the Academy. The post is held by Prof. Dr. Daniela Ganeva.
decisions.reasoning: What is unsettled is a question of Bulgarian law and of the Academy's statutes — institutes of the Academy are structural units, so the signature may sit with the institute or with the Academy — and nothing consulted decides it. The placeholder takes the institute-signs reading and names the Academy as countersignatory, which is the form that is wrong in the smallest way if the Academy holds the signature alone.
decisions.residue: One half is not a placeholder and should survive correction: Prof. Dr. Daniela Ganeva is named as director of the structural unit in the Agricultural Academy's own press record. That is a 2024-era source and must be re-checked before anything is signed. The field binds at partnership-agreement time and reaches no proposal section, so this placeholder buys a phase pass and nothing an evaluator reads.

decisions.answer: The mobility rule is satisfied: 7.05 months of residence or main activity in Hungary within the 36 months before the 2026-09-09 deadline, against a 12-month cap. The CV is not the authoritative record of residence.
decisions.reasoning: The 2026-08-11 override made eligibility conditional on a rectified CV arriving, so the record read as an open question with a deadline. The operator's position of 2026-08-14 removes the condition: the 8.76 months the earlier wording expected the rectified CV to remove are removed on the operator's authority instead. The conditionality is therefore lifted in all five places that carried it, and HOST and FELLOWSHIP_TYPE cease to be CONFIRM — CONDITIONAL. The status stays Assumed and this is not a demurral: runner/working_assumptions.py stamps DECLARED_STATUS 'Assumed' on every declaration wherever it surfaces, and a value reaching Confirmed by declaration would be a green bought by assertion wearing the label of one bought by evidence, which is the single thing the declaration substrate exists to prevent.
decisions.residue: Two periods are fixed points any later residence evidence must stay consistent with, because both are documented outside the CV: KPMG Global Hungary as an employer of record (4.03 months) and the ELTE-documented Erasmus mobility (3.02 months). Eligibility is self-declared at submission and verified at grant agreement preparation, so exposure scales with success and Part A's residence declaration must state what this record states.

decisions.reasoning: The record holds no fact of its own; its status is the roll-up of the fields it enumerates, so it moved only once they did. Assumed rather than Confirmed because the closures are of three kinds and the weakest governs. Its purpose changes with this fold: it was the enumeration of residual gaps for the authorisation packet, and it is now the enumeration of what is written down on someone's authority rather than on evidence. It also gains a still_open list, because what remains genuinely unanswered is no longer an item 12 field but the thin capacity descriptions underneath them.
decisions.residue: Chief among the still-open items is MATE's five-year hyperspectral archive — years, instrument, campaigns, plots, accompanying soil and meteorological data. Gap G2 and hypothesis H2 rest on an asset the proposal describes in one clause.

verification.reader: runner.working_assumptions.load_working_assumptions parses the edited file and returns 21 declarations, no duplicate keys, every entry carrying the four required fields, and every entry rendering at status Assumed in both as_surface() and as_canonical_pack_entries().
verification.tier3: All six edited files parse. No record in consortium/capabilities.json or consortium/partners.json carries validation_status or *_status 'Unresolved'.
verification.not_verified: No phase was run. This record asserts that the Tier 3 inputs to n08a are complete and well-formed, not that n08a passes.

what_this_does_not_do: It does not make three facts true. placement_team_AgroVIR, contact_person_title_AgroVIR and signatory_authority_MVCRI are stand-ins for answers nobody has given, and removing any of them returns its field to Unresolved and re-blocks whatever it unblocked — which is the intended behaviour, not a regression. The operator's stated plan is to correct them by hand in the final draft; working_assumptions.json _operator_placeholders is the register that makes that pass mechanical.
